_comment: Which shipped files work with only one AI tool, and which work with any. The Starter's instructions, skills, hooks, safety settings and AI reviewer are built on Claude Code. The one exception is Codex, which gets the sound hook and a generated AGENTS.md (see its `scope`). No other tool is supported or verified: nothing here claims otherwise. `signatures` are the places a tool's files live: any tracked file matching them must be listed under that tool's `files`, so a new tool-specific file cannot arrive undeclared (tests/aios/test_adapters.py). `verified` needs evidence, and each piece of evidence must resolve to a real test. Verified here means the named tests exercise the file layout and the hook contract with simulated hook input and the real hook command; it is not a recording of a live session. Declared in the Starter's own repository only: release/** is not shipped to client workspaces.

claude-code.scope: file layout and hook contract, tested with simulated hook input and the real hook command; no live-session recording is kept in this repository

codex.scope: the sound hook and AGENTS.md. .codex/hooks.json runs the shared .claude/hooks/notify-sound.js on Stop, SubagentStop and PermissionRequest, tested with simulated hook input and the real hook command; Codex loads it only in a project the user trusts, after they trust the hooks once. AGENTS.md is generated by `aios adapters render` from CLAUDE.md with the operator core inlined (Codex reads it as plain text and doesn't follow `@` imports), must equal that rendering byte for byte, and was loaded by one recorded Codex session in an installed workspace, which answered from it without opening any file (see the run record). Nothing else ships for Codex: no safety hooks, no founder-lane guard (the pull-request boundary check still holds that lane server-side for any tool), and skills are Claude Code folders the agent opens by hand

mixed.tool_specific_part: the `hook pre-edit` command reads Claude Code hook input
mixed.neutral_part: install, upgrade, rollback, verify, release, sanitize, governance, boundary, workspace

mixed.tool_specific_part: parses Claude Code PreToolUse hook JSON for the in-session founder-lane guard
mixed.neutral_part: the pull-request boundary check (check-pr), which holds the same lane server-side for any tool
